messages:
Marta S: Heads up — ShopNordic reporting ~30% spike in card declines for EU B2B orders since 08:40 UTC. Merchant says payments are failing even though customers supplied VAT IDs and POs. :warning:

PayBot: Automated alert: decline_spike_high for merchant=shop_nordic id=mid_7721. Sample decline: charge=ch_1842105600 status=declined acquirer_code=AVS_ADDR_MISMATCH cvv_check=nomatch issuer_response=X34 risk_score=0.17

Jade (AE): Merchant is furious, this is their weekend promo. They want a temporary bypass or guidance ASAP. Ticket #TCK-9921 created.

Alex P: Can you paste the raw acquirer response headers for ch_1842105600 and the billing payload that ShopNordic submitted? Also need BIN (first6) and country of card (if known).

Marta S: Pasting sanitized info below — merchant provided these fields:
```json
{
  "charge_id": "ch_1842105600",
  "card_last4": "4242",
  "card_country": "FR",
  "billing": {
    "name": "Nordic Co",
    "address_line1": "Vesterbrogade 45",
    "city": "København",
    "postal_code": "1620",
    "country": "DK"
  },
  "metadata": {"vat_id":"SE556677889"},
  "po_number": "PO-8899"
}
```
Merchant said they put the VAT into metadata rather than the dedicated vat field in their platform.

Kiran: Two quick suspects: 1) Address normalization mapping 'København' -> 'Denmark' vs expected 'DK' could trigger AVS mismatch if acquirer expects ISO2. 2) VAT in metadata not in billing.vat_id — some acquirers do quick tax validation against the billing country and will decline if VAT/country disagree. We have an old normalization bug logged: GH-443 (addr-normalizer v2.1) that lowercases non-ascii and drops diacritics, resulting in mismatched canonical forms.

Alex P: Acquirer raw snippet for ch_1842105600 (redacted):
```
acquirer_response: DECLINE
avs_result: Z
avs_message: "AVS country mismatch - billing country vs card issuer country"
issuer_code: X34
acquirer: nordic-acq-prod
3ds_status: attempted, liability_shift: none
```
Acquirer is explicitly flagging country mismatch (avs_result Z). CVV also no-match. They also returned a note 'vat_check_failed' in supplemental fields.

Marta S: Repro steps merchant provided to us:
1) Sandbox card 4000 0025 0000 0005 (FR emulation)
2) POST /v1/charges with billing.country=DK and metadata.vat_id=SE556677889 and po_number set
They said it fails in prod only (acquirer routing differs). Repro curl (sanitized):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/charges \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx" \
  -d card[number]=4000000000004242 \
  -d card[exp_month]=12 -d card[exp_year]=2026 \
  -d card[cvc]=123 \
  -d billing[name]="Nordic Co" \
  -d billing[address_line1]="Vesterbrogade 45" \
  -d billing[city]="København" \
  -d billing[postal_code]="1620" \
  -d billing[country]="DK" \
  -d metadata[vat_id]="SE556677889"
```
Result: declined with same acquirer response above.

Alex P: Next steps: 1) Ask merchant to submit VAT in billing.vat_id (not metadata) and retry — low-friction. 2) If still declined, open escalation to nordic-acq-prod with charge id and ask whether they perform cross-border VAT validation vs card issuer country. I can draft escalation. 3) Short-term workaround: enable route_fallback to alt-acquirer for shop_nordic (low friction) so orders can go through while we diagnose.

Kiran: Also check the normalization pipeline — I'll run a quick job to see if addr-normalizer v2.1 canonicalized 'København' to 'Kobenhavn' and whether that mismatches acquirer's expected format. If so, we should hotfix mapping or apply iso-country override upstream for billing.country when country code provided.

Merchant Ops: Merchant asking if we can do manual capture for the queued orders (they have signed PO). What is required on our side to perform an exception?

Alex P: For manual exception we need: charge token, merchant signed PO copy, and an approval from payments ops. If acquirer later disputes we eat the cost. Suggest we only do this for top 10 orders and route rest to fallback acquirer.

Marta S: I'll ask merchant to resubmit with billing.vat_id and try fallback routing. I'm attaching ticket TCK-9921 to the acquirer escalation and tagging Alex for the draft. Will follow up in 30m with result. :eyes:
